items.definition:
a jeweled ornamental band worn on the front of a woman's hair
The princess wore a sparkling tiara.

a stiff brim at the front of a cap or helmet
He pulled down his sun visor to block the glare.

a large marine mammal with long tusks
A walrus can weigh over a ton.

The activity or skill of making or repairing wooden objects and structures.
He learned carpentry from his grandfather.

a great ape native to the forests of tropical Africa.
A chimpanzee is known for its intelligence and social behavior.

a boneless cut of meat or fish
I ordered the salmon fillet with vegetables.

a small rectangular wind instrument with a row of metal reeds
He played a blues tune on his harmonica.

a dog
She took her pooch for a walk in the park.

a large brass wind instrument with a sliding tube
He plays the trombone in the school band.

a North American wild cat with a short tail
We spotted a bobcat near the edge of the forest.

a person who carries a golfer's clubs
The golfer thanked his caddy for helping him choose the right club.

a person who is able to convey or exchange information, news, or ideas, especially one who is skilled at it
He is an excellent communicator, always clear and concise in his emails.

a layer of material that covers something
The ground was covered with a thick covering of snow.

a small bird with a long, slender bill
A hummingbird hovered near the feeder.

A light, airy dessert or hair product.
For dessert, we had a delicious chocolate mousse.

A distinctive smell.
There was a strange odour coming from the kitchen.

A bridge, road, railway, or similar structure that crosses over another.
We drove under the overpass to get to the other side of the highway.

A constellation and zodiac sign.
My sister's zodiac sign is Pisces.

pajamas
He changed into his pyjamas before bed.

sunset
We'll meet at sundown by the old oak tree.

a person who talks, especially one who talks a lot or in a particular way
He's a great talker, always full of interesting stories.

a rotating platform, especially one on which records are played
He carefully placed the vinyl record on the turntable.

a man employed in manual labor
The workman carefully repaired the roof.

a bony growth on the head of a deer
The deer had large antlers on its head.

the slightly sour liquid left after butter has been churned
I used buttermilk to make the pancakes extra fluffy.

a type of hot chili pepper
Add a pinch of cayenne pepper for extra heat.

a chimpanzee
The chimp swung through the trees with ease.

an aromatic plant whose seeds and leaves are used as a herb or spice
I love the fresh taste of coriander in my salsa.

a crocodile (informal)
Be careful near the river; there might be a croc.

a person whose job is to paint and wallpaper rooms
We hired a decorator to paint our living room.

a book of information about a place, designed for visitors
We bought a guidebook to help us explore the city.

a long, loose traditional Japanese robe with wide sleeves
She wore a beautiful silk kimono to the festival.

a South American camelid mammal
The llama carried the heavy load up the mountain.

an apparatus that converts electrical impulses into sound
The announcement was made over the loudspeaker.

belly button
The baby's navel was still healing.

the quality or state of being red
The redness around the cut indicated an infection.

a Y-shaped stick with an elastic band used for shooting small stones
He used a slingshot to knock down the apple from the tree.

A person who drives a truck for a living.
The trucker delivered the goods across the country.

A safety device in a car that inflates rapidly on impact.
The car's airbag deployed during the collision.

a software feature that automatically corrects common spelling errors
My phone's autocorrect changed "duck" to "luck".

the basic monetary unit of Thailand
The exchange rate for the Thai baht is favorable.

a mass of hexagonal wax cells built by honeybees
Bees store honey in the honeycomb.

a program that installs software
You need to run the installer to set up the new application.

A child.
The kiddie rides at the fair were very popular.

A person or thing that sends mail; a piece of promotional material sent by mail.
We received a promotional mailer from the new store.

A person from Nepal.
Many Nepalese live and work abroad.

a nocturnal marsupial
The possum played dead when the dog approached.

a person who saves someone or something from a dangerous or difficult situation
The mountain rescuers found the lost hikers.

a power tool used for smoothing surfaces
He used an electric sander to smooth the wood.

a card or sheet on which scores are recorded
The golf player checked his scorecard after the round.

presentation of images
We watched a slideshow of our vacation photos.

food bought to be eaten elsewhere
Let's order some Chinese takeout tonight.

a tropical root vegetable
Taro is a staple food in many tropical regions.

a person who makes animated films or cartoons
The animator brought the characters to life.

the state of being dry
The dryness of the air caused her skin to crack.

Emergency Medical Technician
The EMT arrived quickly to provide first aid.

the quality of being friendly
Her friendliness made everyone feel welcome.

a common pain reliever and anti-inflammatory drug
I took some ibuprofen for my headache.

a dog of mixed breed; a foolish or incompetent person
Our dog is a lovable mutt with a mix of breeds.

a large toothed whale, also known as a killer whale
An orca breached near the boat.

a smooth, thin-shelled edible nut
She baked a delicious pecan pie.

a small, red, inflamed spot on the skin
She had a small pimple on her chin.

the quality of being polite; courtesy
She always treats everyone with politeness.

a round fruit with a tough, reddish skin and many seeds surrounded by juicy red pulp
I enjoy the sweet and tart taste of pomegranate seeds.
